voiceReason: Jun loves a caring father whose request for silence turns their trust into pressure. Small acts at the gate carry the change.
objective: Explain and evaluate how a studied worldview can lead people to different responses to wrongdoing.
successCriterion: Represent the Confucian claim of family loyalty accurately, explain a serious competing claim, and evaluate a response using a specific detail; no preferred answer about reporting is graded.

characterSignatures.Kevin: Gentle, concrete questions; avoids completing others’ answers; offers a listening role rather than pronouncing the moral.
characterSignatures.Jun: Short loyal promises become questions with boundaries; wraps a gate tie for his father and later puts it beside the unfinished basket.
characterSignatures.Bo: Begins by invoking past care, then names his own manipulation; lowered hands and a held listener beat show what an apology cannot return.
characterSignatures.Shen: Names the missing thing, lost time and terms; refuses praise-seeking shortcuts without denying Jun’s love.
characterSignatures.Clerk: Precise about what he can record and what he cannot guarantee; no invented law or sentence.

directing: Bo recalls carrying Jun home → listener Jun looks at the gate tie → hold a concrete observation → return to father/son pair.
Shen says prior trust mattered → listener Bo lowers empty hands → a separate observation holds the loss → widen to include Jun.
Bo admits buying silence with past care → listener Bo receives Jun’s continued care → gate tie returned beside basket → shared frame and new promise.
physicalWork: Supported reach/give/bow gestures accompany grain carrying, gate work, ribbon sorting or basket work; unnamed objects are narrated/mimed rather than claimed visible props. Ordinary exchanges use two-shots.

storyCircle.want: Jun wants to protect a loved father and keep their trust.
storyCircle.pressure: His father has taken a neighbour’s sheep and wants silence.
storyCircle.change: Jun distinguishes standing beside his father from surrendering his judgement.
storyCircle.payoff: The chosen privacy/report/delay route returns in the final father-son conversation. Each path returns the sheep, preserves Shen’s continuing claim and gives Jun a concrete next commitment. Kevin returns safely.
storyCircle.freshQuestion: How will tomorrow’s promises be checked once the visitor is gone?

teaser.label: sheep_opening_v1
teaser.moment: The stolen sheep calls from behind the household gate.

branches: Six choices, three options each, forward rejoins, distinct replies, no moral score.
presentationSuitability: Concrete details, competing values and costs appear on every route; optional synthesis can compare these two cases.
